venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Nice. Warm but not hot. Sunny.
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 9/27 (MOD/Chef KE / DJ; nice, warm but not hot, sunny).** Net sales $1,301 vs target $1,791 (-27.4%). Food $165. Comps $17.70 (1.36%). 46 guests, check avg $28. A chill but good Sunday — Annie saw a good early pop where most of the food sales came from. A handful of small-to-medium parties, including a birthday group who left and came back, plus a mix of familiar and unfamiliar industry folks. Kitchen: smooth sailing. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Little rainy and killed traffic for The Garden
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 9/27 (Morning/Evening MOD & Chef Maggie H; light rain that killed traffic for the Garden).** Total net sales $8,751.66 vs target $10,700 (-18.2%). Food $1,694. Comps $232.50. 196 guests (Tock), check avg $44.65. No events reported. DC/AM: $1,250.03; D&C (PM): $6,360.41; Garden/6A: $1,141.22. Kitchen: just Maggie H and Dante tonight, ran smooth without a dishwasher — ran out of anchovies, tossed brined scallops; low on lemon aioli, steak flanks, filled tart shells, and cookie dough. Down four people but the team handled it like champs. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 9/27 (MOD/Chef Kyler, Seth, Dante, Will; Nor'Eastern).** Net sales (incl. events) $4,444 vs target $4,310 (+3.1%). Food $477, Beverage $3,967. Comps $220.96 (heavy on employee visits, including a host's birthday visit from LA). 129 guests, check avg $34. A quieter, reflective night with long table times — 4 large parties (2 reservations, 2 walk-ins), 4 solos, 129 covers, 1 investor cocktail. Top sellers: Rosalie, Native Lion, Burner Phone. Door: rainy all night, which didn't deter guests — pretty much full by 8:30pm and busy until 11:30pm, with only a 45-minute waitlist around 10pm. Visits from Stef, Victoria, Haleigh & her sister, and Natalie from Death & Co LA with her dad. 1 no-show (Jacob Y for 2 at 6pm). 1 wine glass broken (guest). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 9/27 (MOD & Chef Joe + Angel).** Net sales $5,157 vs target $5,309 (-2.9%). Food $1,086. Standing Room $0. Comps $75 (industry, birthday, DNL). 134 guests, check avg $99.18. Another busy Sunday — started with just 20 covers, decent large-party walk-ins right after open; steady first couple hours, normal 9pm rush filled the room and started the waitlist; room stayed full until last call; team burned and turned well. Angel held down the kitchen solo. No incidents; no-shows charged. Entered by Joe (submitted 9/28 ~12:33pm ET).

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 9/27 (Shift MOD Josh; light rain).** Total net sales (incl. events) $3,870.24 vs target $2,668 (+45.1%). Food $457. Comps $88.92. Garden closed. 98 guests, check avg ~$39.49 (venue-reported GCA $37.58 / CA $85.26). A cheeky Sunday night with a healthy mix of reservations and walk-ins — busy start with back-to-back larger-party reservations and two-tops escaping the weather, a lull, then business picked back up. The lean Sunday crew communicated well throughout; sold a book, a full Chartreuse flight, and depleted leftover batches. Room stayed ~35% full through last call; guests allowed to linger after close to avoid the rain while waiting for rides. Exceeded target and closed the week strong. Kitchen: hit its 16% target for the day with good tuna crudo, bikini sandwich, and B&B volume. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Another Nice temperate and sunny day
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 9/27 (Morning MOD/Chef Sam/Justin & Shannon/Lex; Evening MOD/Chef Justin & Marcus; another nice, temperate, sunny day).** Total net sales $8,138 vs target $6,341 (+28.3%). Food $2,851. Comps $154. Guests: 67 morning + 113 evening = 180 (OpenTable), check avg $45.21. Morning: steady guests each hour up to a ~10:45am peak, two servers held the floor until noon; quiet from 1pm until happy hour. Evening: a poppin' happy hour with walk-ins and a large food tour, steady 5-7pm, then cut down to a lean crew for a sleepy end to a busy weekend. Sun Club: gorgeous day, lots of food/drink orders (mostly tequila and rum), busy 1-3pm. Hot Eye: a painfully slow Sunday with a small bar crawl and a decent late service-industry pop at 11:30pm; backbar lights still out. Kitchen: slow night, no 86s, low on chilled shrimp (needs prep ASAP). No incidents. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sunday 9/27 (MOD Curtis Hayes // Julian Abel).** Total net sales $8,738 vs target $8,000 (+9.2%). Food $1,360. Comps ~$450 (plus ~$140 in shifties). 169 guests, check avg $51.71. Continues to be a night of folks hanging out post-close without ordering — team got everyone out hospitably before it got too late. Daisy wasn't feeling well and was sent home early with well wishes; Tami killed it solo on barback. A massive table of investors, brought in by Carl, chummed it up with Curtis before he left — lots of fun compendium drinks poured for them. Kitchen: Sfian killed it, with MOD periodically helping with dishes; could use a little extra ABK support when running with just one cook. Uwajima Gimlet 86'd. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by Julian Abel. (Data note: form typed the date as 2026-09-28, but day-of-week 'Sunday' and post time [3:18am ET 9/28] place this report on service date 9/27.)
